integrity: The proof is algebraic and bound-free. A no-carry doubling branch is impossible. In the carry branch, eliminating the low digit from the two cycle equations factors into exactly two linear base branches; one contradicts the necessary carry and the other gives the stated family. Finite enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only two-cycles whose two members are both two-digit in the same base and whose larger member is exactly twice the smaller. It does not classify arbitrary two-cycles. The complete body of the 2010 Hargreaves--Siksek paper was not accessible through the inspected path, so an equivalent observation hidden there is a residual literature risk. Older inspected publication metadata lacked an exact public calendar day; the date field therefore uses the earliest exact public date verified among the inspected archival sources, 2011-07-31 for OEIS A193585.
title: Exhaustive doubling two-cycles of the square-digit happy map
